verses.greek: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία· πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν θεόν, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε.
verses.literal: Not should be troubled of you the heart You believe in the God also in Me myself believe.
verses.dgt: “Do not let your heart be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me.

verses.greek: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν· εἰ δὲ μή, εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν·
verses.literal: In the house of the Father of Mine mansions many there are — lest then surely I have told then would you — that I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.dgt: In my Father’s house are many dwelling places. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?

verses.greek: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν, πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε.
verses.literal: And if I shall go and shall prepare a place for you again I am coming and I will receive you to Myself that where am I myself also you yourselves may be.
verses.dgt: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I am coming again and will take you to myself, so that where I am, you also may be.

verses.greek: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν.
verses.literal: And to the place I myself am going you know the way
verses.dgt: And you know the way where I am going.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς· Κύριε, οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις· πῶς δυνάμεθα τὴν ὁδὸν εἰδέναι;
verses.literal: Says to Him Thomas Lord not we know where You are going how can we the way to know?
verses.dgt: Thomas says to him, “Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή· οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν πατέρα εἰ μὴ διʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus I myself am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father only except through Me.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to him, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

verses.greek: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε· ἀπʼ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε αὐτόν.
verses.literal: If you had known Me also the Father of Mine then you would have known from now you know Him and you have seen Him.
verses.dgt: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on you know him and have seen him.”

verses.greek: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος· Κύριε, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: Says to Him Philip Lord do show us the Father and it is enough for us.
verses.dgt: Philip says to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that is enough for us.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με, Φίλιππε; ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα· πῶς σὺ λέγεις· Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα;
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus So long a time with you am I and not you have known Me Philip? The one having seen Me myself he has seen the Father how you yourself say do show us the Father?’
verses.dgt: Jesus says to him, “Have I been with you so long, and you have not known me, Philip? The one who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

verses.greek: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν; τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ, ὁ δὲ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Surely you believe that I myself am in the Father and the Father in Me myself is? The declarations that I myself I say to you from Myself not I speak the but the Father in Me myself dwelling does the works of Him.
verses.dgt: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words that I say to you I do not speak from myself, but the Father remaining in me does his works.

verses.greek: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί· εἰ δὲ μή, διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ πιστεύετε.
verses.literal: do believe Me that I myself am in the Father and the Father in Me myself lest then except because of the works themselves do believe
verses.dgt: Believe me that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; otherwise believe because of the works themselves.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει, καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει, ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα πορεύομαι·
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you the one believing in Me myself the works that I myself do also he will do and greater than these he will do because I myself to the Father am going.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: the one who believes in me will also do the works that I do, and he will do greater than these, because I am going to the Father.

verses.greek: καὶ ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ·
verses.literal: And which one maybe you may ask in the name of Me this will I do so that may be glorified the Father in the Son.
verses.dgt: And whatever you ask in my name, I will do this, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.greek: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐγὼ ποιήσω.
verses.literal: If anything you shall ask Me in the name of Me I myself will do it.
verses.dgt: If you ask me anything in my name, I will do it.

verses.greek: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με, τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς τηρήσετε·
verses.literal: If you shall love Me the commandments the of Mine you will keep.
verses.dgt: If you love me, you will keep my commands.

verses.greek: κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ᾖ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,
verses.literal: And I myself will ask the Father and another Helper He will give you that He may be with you to the age
verses.dgt: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate, so that he may be with you forever,

verses.greek: τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν, ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει· ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό, ὅτι παρʼ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται.
verses.literal: the Spirit the of truth whom the world not is able to receive because not it does see Him nor know But you yourselves know Him for with you He abides and in you He will be.
verses.dgt: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive because it does not see him or know him. You know him, because he remains with you and will be in you.

verses.greek: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς, ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: Not I will leave you as orphans I am coming to you.
verses.dgt: I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you.

verses.greek: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ, ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με, ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ζήσετε.
verses.literal: Yet a little while and the world Me no longer sees you yourselves however see Me because I myself live also you yourselves will live.
verses.dgt: A little while longer and the world sees me no more, but you see me. Because I live, you also will live.

verses.greek: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: In that very the day will know you yourselves that I myself am in the Father of Mine and you yourselves in Me myself and I myself in you.
verses.dgt: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

verses.greek: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με· ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν.
verses.literal: The one having the commandments of Mine and keeping them he is the one loving Me the one now loving Me he will be loved by the Father of Mine and I myself will love him and I will show to him Myself.
verses.dgt: The one who has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. And the one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and reveal myself to him.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας, οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης· Κύριε, τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ;
verses.literal: Says to Him Judas not the Iscariot Lord what has occurred that to us You are about to manifest Yourself and not to the world?
verses.dgt: Judas, not Iscariot, says to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are going to reveal yourself to us and not to the world?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρʼ αὐτῷ ποιησόμεθα.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to him If anyone shall love Me the word of Mine he will keep and the Father of Mine will love him and to him we will come and a home with him we will make.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves me, he will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our dwelling with him.

verses.greek: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ· καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με πατρός.
verses.literal: The one not loving Me the words of Mine not does keep and the word that you hear not it is Mine but of the One who having sent Me the Father.
verses.dgt: The one who does not love me does not keep my words. And the word that you hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

verses.greek: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρʼ ὑμῖν μένων·
verses.literal: These things I have said to you with you abiding
verses.dgt: I have spoken these things to you while remaining with you.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ παράκλητος, τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: The however Helper the Spirit the Holy whom will send the Father in the name of Me He you will teach all things and He will bring to remembrance of you all things that have said to you
verses.dgt: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and will remind you of all that I said to you.

verses.greek: εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν· οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν. μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω.
verses.literal: Peace I leave with you peace the of Mine I give to you not even as the world gives I myself give to you. Not should be troubled of you the heart nor should it fear.
verses.dgt: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.

verses.greek: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν· Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς. εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν, ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν.
verses.literal: You heard that I myself said to you I am going away and I am coming to you. If you were loving Me you have rejoiced then would that I am going to the Father because the Father greater than I is.
verses.dgt: You heard that I said to you, ‘I am going away, and I am coming to you.’ If you loved me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

verses.greek: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι, ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε.
verses.literal: And now I have told you before it comes to pass that when it may happen you may believe.
verses.dgt: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens you may believe.

verses.greek: οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθʼ ὑμῶν, ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων· καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν,
verses.literal: no longer much I will speak with you comes for the the world ruler and in Me myself not he has no thing
verses.dgt: I will no longer speak much with you, for the ruler of the world is coming. He has nothing in me,

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ καθὼς ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ πατὴρ οὕτως ποιῶ. Ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν.
verses.literal: but that may know the world that I love the Father and even as He has commanded to Me the Father thus I do. do rise up let us go from here.
verses.dgt: but this happens so that the world may know that I love the Father, and just as the Father commanded me, so I do. Get up; let us go from here.
